meaning_en: a special skill in dealing with people or things
example_en: She has a way with children; they always listen.
examples_extra: She has a way with children — they all adore her.
He has a way with words that makes speeches memorable.
note_fa: «یعنی مهارت خاص در برخورد با کسی یا چیزی: have a way with people.»

meaning_en: completely unreasonable or silly
example_en: That idea is completely absurd; it makes no sense.
examples_extra: It is absurd to drive for an hour to save one euro.
The idea sounded absurd at first, but it worked.
note_fa: «یعنی «مضحک و غیرمنطقی»؛ در کتاب هم‌معنی ridiculous.»

meaning_en: public praise and approval for someone or something
example_en: The film received international acclaim from critics.
examples_extra: Her first novel won great critical acclaim.
The young director received international acclaim.
note_fa: «تحسین عمومی؛ critical acclaim یعنی تحسین منتقدان.»

meaning_en: publicly praised and admired
example_en: She is an acclaimed author with many awards.
examples_extra: The acclaimed author will sign books on Friday.
It was an acclaimed performance by the young cast.

meaning_en: One of a group of similar things.
example_en: She is among the best students in her class.
examples_extra: He is among the best players in the team.
This book ranks among her finest works.
note_fa: یعنی «جزوِ» یک گروه: among the best.

meaning_en: Responsible for a mistake or problem.
example_en: The driver was at fault for the accident.
examples_extra: The driver was at fault in the accident.
She admitted she was at fault and said sorry.

meaning_en: Excellent; the best of its kind.
example_en: Her new car is the bee's knees!
examples_extra: Everyone says this new phone is the bee’s knees.
His home-made pizza is the bee’s knees, I think.
note_fa: اصطلاح غیررسمی برای ستایش؛ همیشه با the می‌آید.

meaning_en: To say someone is responsible for something bad.
example_en: Don't blame me for your mistakes.
examples_extra: You cannot blame him for the broken window.
She blamed the rain for her late arrival.

meaning_en: In a very clever or excellent way.
example_en: She performed brilliantly in the play.
examples_extra: She plays the piano brilliantly and always receives a big applause.
The team worked brilliantly together and finished the project a week early.
note_fa: یعنی با مهارت و درخشش — برای اجرا و کارِ عالی به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: Someone or something that is excellent or superior.
example_en: He thinks he's the cat's whiskers.
examples_extra: Since his promotion, he thinks he's the cat's whiskers.
Her new dress made her feel like the cat's whiskers.

meaning_en: A rule that must be true for something to happen.
example_en: One condition of the job is speaking French.
examples_extra: You can borrow my car on one condition.
One condition of the job is that you speak English.
note_fa: on condition that = به شرط آنکه.

meaning_en: Expressing disapproval or finding fault.
example_en: He was very critical of my work.
examples_extra: The report is highly critical of the factory.
She is always critical of my cooking.

meaning_en: In a way that expresses disapproval or judgment.
example_en: She looked critically at the painting.
examples_extra: He was critically ill after the accident.
The film was critically acclaimed.

meaning_en: To say what you think is wrong with something.
example_en: Don't criticise her; she tried her best.
examples_extra: She criticised the government's plan.
The teacher criticised our pronunciation.

meaning_en: To deal with a difficult situation.
example_en: We must face our problems bravely.
examples_extra: We must face the problem together.
The team faces a difficult match tomorrow.
note_fa: face a problem یعنی «روبرو شدن با مشکل».

meaning_en: Excellent; of the very best quality.
example_en: The restaurant serves first-rate food and wine.
examples_extra: This restaurant serves first-rate food at fair prices.
He is a first-rate teacher who truly cares.

meaning_en: The ability to speak easily and well.
meaning_fa: فن بیان، زبان چرب و نرم
example_en: He has the gift of the gab; he can talk to anyone.
examples_extra: He has the gi of the gab and can sell anything.
With her gi of the gab, she charmed the audience.

meaning_en: a natural ability to make plants grow well.
example_en: My aunt has green fingers; her garden is lovely.
examples_extra: She has green fingers, look at her roses!
My grandmother has green fingers too.

word: have your cake and eat it
meaning_en: Want two good things that are impossible together.
meaning_fa: هم خدا را خواستن هم خرما
example_en: You can't have your cake and eat it too.
examples_extra: You can't have your cake and eat it.
She wants a big house and lots of travel; she can't have her cake and eat it.
note_fa: نمی‌شود هر دو خوبی را با هم داشت.

meaning_en: Much better than others.
example_en: Her performance was head and shoulders above the rest.
examples_extra: She is head and shoulders above the other candidates.
This restaurant is head and shoulders above the rest.
note_fa: خیلی بهتر از بقیه؛ کتاب: much better than.

meaning_en: Very much; to a great degree.
example_en: She is a highly respected doctor.
examples_extra: She is a highly skilled doctor.
The film was highly recommended by critics.

meaning_en: Not feeling well, sick.
example_en: She felt ill and went home from school.
examples_extra: She was too ill to go to school.
He felt ill after the meal.

meaning_en: Having great value or meaning.
example_en: It's important to listen carefully in class.
examples_extra: It is important to drink water daily.
She gave an important speech.

meaning_en: Much; a lot.
example_en: This new phone is miles better than my old one.
examples_extra: She's miles better at maths than me.
This hotel is miles better than the last one.
note_fa: غیررسمی: یعنی «خیلی»؛ miles better than یعنی خیلی بهتر از.

meaning_en: Quick to understand and react.
example_en: You need to be on the ball to succeed in this job.
examples_extra: Our new manager is really on the ball.
You need to be on the ball in this job.

meaning_en: Extremely good or impressive.
example_en: The food at that restaurant was out of this world.
examples_extra: The food at that restaurant is out of this world.
Her performance was out of this world.

meaning_en: to find faults or weaknesses in something.
example_en: It's easy to pick holes in other people's plans.
examples_extra: He is always picking holes in my plans.
Do not pick holes in every idea.
note_fa: اصطلاح: ایراد گرفتن و عیب‌جویی کردن.

meaning_en: To express approval or admiration for someone.
example_en: The teacher praised her good work.
examples_extra: The teacher praised her work.
He praised the team for winning.

meaning_en: truly, in fact
example_en: I really like this song.
examples_extra: I really enjoyed the concert last night.
Do you really believe his story?
note_fa: واقعاً؛ برای تأکید قبل از فعل.

meaning_en: To criticize someone unfairly.
example_en: Don't run down your colleagues in public.
examples_extra: Why do you always run me down?
She ran down his ideas.

meaning_en: Much better than others.
example_en: Her new design is streets ahead of the old one.
examples_extra: Our team is streets ahead of the rest.
She is streets ahead of her classmates.

meaning_en: To be the most surprising or annoying.
example_en: His excuse really takes the biscuit!
examples_extra: That really takes the biscuit!
His rudeness takes the biscuit.

meaning_en: The absolute worst of its kind.
example_en: This is the world's worst coffee I've ever tasted.
examples_extra: That was the world's worst film.
I had the world's worst headache.

meaning_en: An indirect compliment that also implies criticism.
example_en: Her back-handed compliment about my dress was annoying.
examples_extra: That was a back-handed compliment.
She made a back-handed remark.
note_fa: یعنی «تعریف کنایه‌دار»؛ ظاهراً مثبت ولی منفی.

meaning_en: To be highly admired and celebrated by.
example_en: After his victory, he was the toast of the town.
examples_extra: After her gold medal, she became the toast of the nation.
The young chef will be the toast of the city's food scene.
note_fa: the toast of: محبوب و تحسین‌شده همه.

meaning_en: An expression of praise or admiration.
example_en: She received a compliment on her new hairstyle.
examples_extra: Just take it as a compliment, not criticism.
She spent the evening fishing for compliments.
note_fa: «تعریف و تمجید»؛ pay a compliment؛ با complement فرق دارد.

meaning_en: A person who tries to gain favor by flattering others.
example_en: Nobody respects him; he's such a crawler, always praising the boss.
examples_extra: He's such a crawler with the boss.
Don't be a crawler; speak honestly.

meaning_en: To praise someone so weakly that it implies criticism.
example_en: His review damned the play with faint praise, calling it "adequate."
examples_extra: The review damned the restaurant with faint praise, calling the food merely edible.
Her boss damned her with faint praise, saying her work was adequate at best.
note_fa: تعریف بی‌میل که بوی انتقاد می‌دهد.

meaning_en: Having both positive and negative consequences.
meaning_fa: دو لبه، دارای مزایا و معایب
example_en: The new policy is a double-edged sword for the economy.
examples_extra: Fame is truly a double-edged sword indeed.
That was rather a double-edged compliment, honestly.

meaning_en: To praise the advantages of something highly.
example_en: The advertisement extolled the benefits of the new software.
examples_extra: The adverts extol the benefits of the new drug.
He never stops extolling the benefits of cycling.
note_fa: ستودن مزایا؛ بسیار تعریف کردن از خوبی‌ها.

meaning_en: To praise the good qualities of something highly.
example_en: The speaker extolled the virtues of hard work.
examples_extra: Critics extol the virtues of the new design.
She extols the virtues of a simple life.
note_fa: ستودن فضایل؛ تعریف از ویژگی‌های خوب.

meaning_en: To try to make people praise you.
example_en: She was clearly fishing for compliments about her new dress.
examples_extra: She is always fishing for compliments.
Stop fishing for compliments now!

meaning_en: To praise someone excessively, often insincerely.
example_en: He tried to flatter his boss to get a promotion.
examples_extra: She flattered him quite shamelessly.
Don't flatter me; just be honest.

meaning_en: A person who praises others excessively or insincerely.
example_en: Nobody trusts him; he's a known flatterer.
examples_extra: He is just a flatterer.
Beware of flatterers at the court.

meaning_en: Insincere praise will not help you achieve your goal.
example_en: "Flattery will get you nowhere!" she told her persistent admirer.
examples_extra: Flattery will get you nowhere, so stop it.
Remember, flattery will get you nowhere!

meaning_en: Express admiration or approval for someone or something.
example_en: The coach gave praise to the team for their effort.
examples_extra: Give praise to the whole team.
The teacher gave praise to her students.

word: give someone a pat on the back
meaning_en: Praise someone for doing something well.
example_en: The manager gave him a pat on the back for finishing early.
examples_extra: Give yourself a pat on the back.
The boss gave him a pat on the back.

meaning_en: To give a lot of praise to someone.
meaning_fa: غرق در ستایش کردن، بسیار تحسین کردن
example_en: The critics heaped praise on the new play.
examples_extra: Critics heaped praise on the film.
They heaped praise on her cooking.
note_fa: اصطلاح: خیلی تعریف و تمجید کردن.

meaning_en: Deserving praise and commendation.
example_en: His efforts to help the homeless were truly laudable.
examples_extra: It was a laudable attempt to help.
Her aims are entirely laudable.

meaning_en: Expressing praise or commendation.
example_en: The review was filled with laudatory comments about the novel.
examples_extra: The play received laudatory reviews.
He wrote a laudatory speech about her.

meaning_en: To behave in an excessively humble or subservient way.
example_en: He'd lick anyone's boots to get a promotion.
examples_extra: He would lick the boss's boots for promotion.
She refuses to lick anyone's boots.

meaning_en: To try to please someone, often to gain favor.
example_en: He tried to make up to his boss for his mistake.
examples_extra: He keeps making up to his new boss.
She made up to the teacher for praise.

meaning_en: Excessively eager to please or obey; fawning.
example_en: The obsequious assistant always praised his boss excessively.
examples_extra: He is obsequious to the boss.
Her obsequious manner annoys me.

meaning_en: To praise someone for doing something well.
example_en: The coach patted the team on the back for their effort.
examples_extra: Pat yourself on the back.
The coach patted him on the back.

meaning_en: To say something nice to someone.
example_en: He paid her a compliment on her new hairstyle.
examples_extra: He paid her a compliment.
She paid me a lovely compliment.

meaning_en: To show respect and admiration for someone.
example_en: The ceremony paid tribute to the fallen soldiers.
examples_extra: They will pay tribute to the victims.
The concert will pay tribute to her career.

meaning_en: An expression of praise or approval.
example_en: The play received widespread plaudits from critics.
examples_extra: The new film won critical plaudits everywhere.
Critics gave the book plaudits.

meaning_en: To praise someone or something enthusiastically.
example_en: Critics praised her performance to the skies.
examples_extra: Critics praised the film to the skies.
The coach praised her to the skies.
note_fa: تا حد پرستش ستودن؛ بسیار تحسین کردن.

meaning_en: Deserving approval or admiration; commendable.
example_en: Her dedication to charity work is truly praiseworthy.
examples_extra: Her praiseworthy efforts saved the club.
It was a praiseworthy attempt, though it failed.

meaning_en: Excessively eager to serve or please others.
example_en: His servile attitude annoyed his colleagues.
examples_extra: He played a servile role.
Her servile manner annoyed me.

meaning_en: To give someone a lot of compliments.
example_en: The critics showered praise on the new play.
examples_extra: They showered praise on the team.
Critics shower praise on her.

meaning_en: To praise someone enthusiastically.
example_en: The manager always sings her praises.
examples_extra: Critics sing her praises loudly.
They sing the chef's praises.

meaning_en: Unpleasantly polite and insincere, often to gain advantage.
example_en: He gave a slimy smile, trying to win her over.
examples_extra: The raw fish felt slimy.
He's a slimy dishonest salesman.

meaning_en: Excessively flattering or ingratiating; insincere.
example_en: His smarmy compliments made everyone uncomfortable.
examples_extra: He gave a smarmy smile.
I dislike his smarmy manner.

meaning_en: To flatter someone to gain favor (informal).
example_en: He's always sucking up to the boss.
examples_extra: He sucks up to the boss.
She is always sucking up to teachers.

meaning_en: Interpret something said as praise.
example_en: He told me I looked tired; I didn't take it as a compliment.
examples_extra: Take it as a compliment, not criticism.
She takes every comment as a compliment.

meaning_en: Over a large area or by many people.
meaning_fa: به طور گسترده، به طور وسیع
example_en: His new book has been widely praised.
examples_extra: The good news spread widely.
She is widely respected here.
